subject: Gamma Corp - SOC 2 Type II evidence & transfer options
messages:
From: Elena Park <security@gammacorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: sam.wong@gammacorp.com; audits@gammacorp.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request and evidence transfer

Hi Rishi,

Hope you're well. We're kicking off our vendor security review for the 2027 audit cycle and need the following from Redwood to complete Gamma's vendor risk assessment: 

- SOC 2 Type II report covering the most recent 12-month period you have (we typically request reports that overlap our fiscal year: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31).
- If your attestation period does not include our target window, a signed bridge letter describing whether controls changed materially in the requested period.
- A short evidence index (CSV or spreadsheet) listing artifacts you can share (logs/retention policies/backup evidence/GCP account scoping) and an expected ETA for delivery.
- Preferred secure transfer mechanisms (SFTP, secure pre-signed S3, or secure portal). We need documentation delivered to our security mailbox (security@gammacorp.com) and a copy to our external auditor (audits@gammacorp.com).

Could you confirm what you can provide and the earliest delivery date? Also let us know if there are any redaction or NDAs required.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Vendor Security | Gamma Corp

--
Elena Park
Gamma Corp
security@gammacorp.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <security@gammacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, sam.wong@gammacorp.com, audits@gammacorp.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and evidence transfer

Thanks, Elena — appreciate the clear list. Looping in Monica (Security Ops) and Laura (Customer Success) to coordinate intake and transfer.

Short answer: we can provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report, a signed bridge letter (when applicable), and a high-level evidence index. A few notes up front so expectations are aligned:

- Coverage: Our most recent Type II covers 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 and the scope includes Redwood Inference production runtime, API control plane, and relevant change-management and incident response controls. If you need an expanded scope (e.g., dedicated/private deployment artifacts), flag that and we'll add items to the index.
- Bridge letters: If the report period doesn't match your requirement, we provide a standard bridge letter signed by our Head of Security. The bridge letter notes any changes to control design and operating effectiveness in the interim and confirms no material control deviations occurred.
- Evidence index: we'll provide a CSV that maps control IDs to representative artifacts (log extracts, policy docs, configuration screenshots, retention schedules). NOTE: we don't share raw logs without an executed NDA and a scope-limited transfer agreement with retention/handling terms — we typically provide extracts or redacted samples for initial reviews.
- Transfer options: secure pre-signed S3 link (preferred), Box/ShareFile link with password+expiry, or direct SFTP drop (we can create a temporary account). For auditor ingestion we can also provide an auditor-access token to our secure portal for time-bound download.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm the exact audit window and whether the Type II report date above is acceptable (it covers 2026 calendar year).
2) Confirm your preferred transfer method and whether Gamma's external auditor needs its own access.
3) We'll prepare the report and evidence index and target delivery within 3 business days after confirmation (may be earlier for report PDFs).

I'll attach a draft evidence index and the standard transfer instructions to this thread — Monica will be the point for secure uploads.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
Attachments: transfer_instructions.txt, redwood_evidence_index.csv

Thanks Rishi — quick clarifications from Gamma audit team: 

- The principal coverage we need is the 2026 calendar year; your stated period (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31) works.
- The auditor prefers either a pre-signed S3 link or direct SFTP drop. Pre-signed S3 with time-limited links is our first choice.
- For raw logs: we'll take redacted samples first. If the auditor requests additional artifacts, they'll initiate a scoped data request and sign the necessary transfer agreement.

Could you confirm the file names and which documents will be in the package so we can pre-populate our tracker?

Appreciate it — Sam
